thread:
maya: heads up — main turned red right after that fast-merge (PR #6423). CI run 4827 failing on integration/gpu-smoke and tests::kvcache::shard_alloc. Anyone around to grab this? :grimacing:
ci-bot: pipeline: https://ci.redwoodinfra.internal/runs/4827 — status: FAILED stage: integration (gpu-smoke) job: shard-alloc (exit 1)
ops-bot: rerun available: /ci rerun 4827 --stage integration --jobs gpu-smoke,shard-alloc
jordan: pinging @ali and @sara since those tests touched kvcache recently. ali, any idea if the recent alloc change could cause this?
ali: saw a flake in local debug last night but thought it was infra noise. will look now. can someone dump the failing log?
maya: copying the log snippet we get on the job: 
```
# failure excerpt
ASSERT at src/kvcache/shard.cc:142
  free_list empty when allocating for size 4096
Stack: kvcache::allocate -> shard::alloc_block -> allocator::pop_free
Error: attempted to pop from empty free_list
Exit code 1
```
jordan: thanks. that looks like a regression in free-list handling. ali — if you can reproduce locally run the unit with TRACE=1: 
```bash
RUST_LOG=trace cargo test tests::kvcache::shard_alloc -- --nocapture
```
ali: starting a quick local run. if it reproduces i'll bisect between main~3..main
sara: FYI I kicked a rerun (ops-bot did it) to see if it's flaky: /ci rerun 4827 --quick; results should be in ~6m
ci-bot: rerun 4827 (quick) started on runner gpu-08; job gpu-smoke queued
maya: appreciate the rerun — if it stays red, we should do a targeted bisect on PRs touching kvcache in the last 4 merges. Jordan can you list the candidate commits?
jordan: candidates: commit a7c3b5 (PR #6419), commit d4e21f (PR #6421), commit f9b12a (PR #6423 - the fast-merge). i'll post the short git range command: 
```bash
git log --pretty=oneline --abbrev=8 --grep="kvcache" main~5..main
```
ali: local run is reproducing with TRACE — looks deterministic for me. starting bisection now. will post results ASAP. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sara: quick note — routing policy had a fallback change yesterday; not sure if that touches alloc but flagging infra changes in case.
maya: good call. ops can you confirm if any infra PRs landed in that window?
ops-bot: infra PRs merged in last 6 hours: infra/telemetry-fallback (c3f9d2), infra/runner-labels (b221a8)
jordan: OK, two infra hits but neither mentions kvcache. ali, if bisection points to f9b12a (PR #6423) we should consider squashing a revert or hotfix. can you post the bisect result and failing test output?
ali: bisect result: commit f9b12a introduced the regression. reproduces locally and in CI. minimal repro attached.
maya: thanks. @jordan can you draft a revert PR? we should block auto-merge until this is fixed. also let's mute the flaky test if it's blocking other work for now.
jordan: will open revert (PR #6424) in ~10m and add hold on auto-merge queue. also adding a flaky test mute to the pipeline to unblock other merges — tagging infra/eng on the change.
sara: monitoring the rerun — if it turns green we still should revert since local repro is solid.
maya: agreed. ali — can you add a short postmortem note in the PR explaining root cause and a test to catch it?
ali: yep will include root cause + new unit that asserts free_list invariants. will run full CI after revert lands.
maya: thanks all. keeping this thread for updates. :white_check_mark:
